title: Technical Lead
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on
**Founding AI Platform Architect / Principal AI Engineer**
to own the architecture and development of an AI-native delivery platform from the ground up.

This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role for someone who has experience building and deploying production-grade AI/LLM systems, designing agent orchestration frameworks, and leading small engineering teams.

You will own the company's core technical IP, personally lead the development of the first production-ready MVP within four weeks, and build the engineering foundation for future scale.

The role combines
**AI architecture, backend engineering, agent orchestration, technical leadership, and client-facing delivery.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI Platform Architecture & Development**

* Own the end-to-end architecture of the AI-native delivery platform, covering workflow planning, execution, quality, oversight, and auditability.
* Personally lead the development and launch of the first production-ready version within four weeks.
* Design and build the core orchestration engine using LangGraph or similar frameworks.
* Implement durable, checkpointed workflows with human-in-the-loop approval mechanisms, including pause, resume, and recovery capabilities.
* Make human oversight central to the architecture, ensuring every AI-generated action requires human approval and every decision is recorded with proper attribution.
* Build an immutable, append-only audit system with complete event history and hash-chained records.

**2. AI Quality, Evaluation & Cost Optimisation**

* Establish an evals-first engineering culture using golden datasets and regression testing for every AI agent.
* Define measurable acceptance criteria for agent outputs and ensure prompt changes follow the same testing discipline as code changes.
* Build telemetry to track token consumption, cost, and latency at every workflow step.
* Establish cost-per-story visibility and continuously optimise model selection and usage to maintain unit economics.

**3. Engineering Leadership & Team Building**

* Recruit, hire, and lead a small team of up to five senior platform engineers.
* Remain hands-on with daily coding, architecture, implementation, and technical problem-solving.
* Establish strong engineering practices, development standards, and documentation from day one.
* Ensure the platform is scalable, maintainable, and not dependent on any single engineer.
* Make pragmatic build-vs-buy and technology decisions while managing technical risks and delivery timelines.

**4. Client Implementation & Technical Stakeholder Management**

* Work directly with client delivery teams to ensure successful platform implementation and adoption.
* Translate real-world client requirements, legacy systems, inconsistent documentation, and regulatory constraints into practical technical solutions.
* Personally demonstrate the platform and engage with client technology, engineering, and compliance stakeholders.
* Communicate the technical roadmap, implementation capabilities, and delivery timelines credibly.
* Build client trust through transparent communication and measurable results.
* Be available for key client milestones, implementation activities, and go-live requirements.

**5. Security, Compliance & Governance**

* Design the platform with security, auditability, and compliance readiness built into its architecture.
* Build toward standards and controls associated with SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, GDPR, and HIPAA.
* Ensure appropriate authentication, authorisation, encryption, secrets management, and data protection mechanisms.
* Make compliance a natural outcome of the platform architecture, formalising processes as the business scales.

**Customer-Facing Expectations**

This is not a back-office architecture role. The candidate must be comfortable working directly with clients from the beginning.

During the initial four-week MVP development phase, client interactions will primarily involve platform demonstrations, with founders managing day-to-day customer engagement.

Once the platform is launched, the role will involve greater direct interaction with clients, including technical discussions, implementation, and go-live support.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 8+ years of overall software engineering experience, including significant experience in technical leadership or architecture roles.
* Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, Technical Architect, or equivalent engineering leadership background.
* Proven experience building and deploying AI/LLM-powered systems in production environments, beyond prototypes or side projects.
* Strong experience designing and owning end-to-end system architecture.
* Previous experience leading small, senior engineering teams of up to five members.
* Hands-on experience in 0-to-1 product development or early-stage startup environments is preferred.
* Experience in client-facing technical delivery or professional services is a strong advantage.
* Experience working with regulated industries, particularly Healthcare & Life Sciences or Financial Services, is highly preferred.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Technical Skills Required**

**1. AI & Agent Orchestration**

* Strong hands-on experience with LangGraph or similar workflow orchestration frameworks.
* Experience designing durable, checkpointed state machines and workflow graphs.
* Understanding of human-in-the-loop mechanisms, graph interrupts, and pause/resume/recovery semantics.
* Hands-on experience building AI agents and LLM-powered production systems.
* Strong understanding of prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, tool calling, and schema-validated outputs.

**2. AI Evaluation & Observability**

* Experience building golden-dataset evaluation and regression-testing frameworks.
* Ability to define acceptance criteria and measure AI agent performance.
* Understanding of prompt versioning, evaluation pipelines, and systematic testing.
* Experience tracking LLM token usage, latency, and cost at individual workflow and task levels.
* Knowledge of model selection and cost optimisation strategies.

**3. Backend & Database Engineering**

* Strong proficiency in Python (Python 3.12).
* Working proficiency in TypeScript.
* Experience with FastAPI or comparable backend frameworks.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs and event-driven architecture.
* Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and pgvector.
* Familiarity with embedding-based search, repository indexing, and code chunking approaches such as Tree-sitter.

**4. Frontend & Cloud Infrastructure**

* Working knowledge of React and TypeScript to guide and review internal console development.
* Strong cloud infrastructure experience, preferably AWS.
* Experience with Docker, Terraform, and GitHub Actions.
* Exposure to Azure and Google Cloud is an added advantage.

**5. Developer Tools & Security**

* Practical experience with modern agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of authentication, authorisation, secrets management, and encryption at rest and in transit.
* Experience designing secure, auditable systems aligned with compliance requirements.
* Experience integrating with developer and IT service-management tools.
* GitHub App and Jira Cloud integration experience is a strong advantage.

title: Principal - SAP Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The SAP Infrastructure Engineer builds and runs both the Cloud and On-Prem SAP Infrastructure platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in automating away toil.
  
  
This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Adopt engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Work with principal engineers and partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

* Overall 10 Years and typically 5-7 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Experience in cloud infrastructure management, preferably with ERP systems. Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on either Azure or Google Cloud. Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on VMware
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

description:
**About Agoda**

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

**Get to Know our Team:**

In Agoda’s Back End Engineering department, we build the scalable, fault-tolerant systems and APIs that host our core business logic. Our systems cover all major areas of our business: inventory and pricing, product information, customer data, communications, partner data, booking systems, payments, and more. These mission-critical systems change frequently with dozens of releases per day, so we must employ state-of-the-art CI/CD and testing techniques in order to make sure everything works without any downtime. We also ensure that our systems are self-healing, responding gracefully to extreme loads or unexpected input. In order to accomplish this, we use state-of-the-art languages like Scala and Go, data technologies like Kafka and Aerospike, and agile development practices. Most importantly though, we hire great people from all around the world and empower them to be successful. Whether it’s building new projects like Flights and Packages or reimagining our existing business, you’ll make a big impact as part of the Back End Engineering team.

**The Opportunity:**

The Engineering Manager role at Agoda is one of the most significant and challenging roles at the company. The right candidate is both extremely hands on – technically excellent, with solid engineering principles – and exhibits strong leadership and people development skills. We are looking for world class development managers to lead one or more of our engineering teams.

**In this Role, you'll get to:**

* Be hands on - its one of the job’s fundamental task, and most of our development managers are writing and reviewing code, giving expert level coaching and guidance to their engineers.
* It's important to have a love of engineering and a passion for building things elegantly and at scale. Staying in touch with where the industry is going is crucial, and it’s important to have strong opinions about how systems should be architected, engineered, and maintained.
* Do full stack engineering: you should have solid experience in all parts of the technology stack: infrastructure, client side, back end, performance, data, and others.
* Developing people - Despite our investment and belief in technology, people are still our greatest asset. The right candidate will have a keen interest in developing people: inspiring those around them so they can achieve their potential. Being able to bring A-players such as yourself from outside and integrating them into the business will also be important.

**What you'll Need to Succeed:**

* Extremely proficient in at least 1 programming language (Java, Scala, C#)
* Strong experience in systems architecture – particularly in complex, scalable and fault tolerant distributed systems
* Demonstrable experience as a system owner with operational responsibility
* Proficient in lower level engineering (Garbage collection, context switching, threading)
* DevOps culture – Agility. Leanness. Automation. CI/CD
* Good understanding of application security
* Passionate about technology and the Internet
* Must have worked in a successful agile development team
* Must have run engineering teams before with 5+ direct reports
* Able to operate with autonomously: making decisions, setting KPIs, with a strong sense of ownership
* Practices data driven decision making

**It's Great if you have:**

* Proficiency in more than one programming language

**This position is based in Gurugram, India. Relocation package will be provided.**
